description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹生成式人工智慧於室内設計之應用，涵蓋AI圖像與文本生成工具的操作實務、參數化設計基礎，以及AI生成流程導入設計思考，培養學生具備數位設計與創意表達能力。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the application of generative Al interior design, including practical training on AI image and text generation tools, fundamentals of parametric design, and integration of AI into the design thing process. Students will develop digital design literacy and creative communication skills.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: 平時成績 10 分為基準
每次缺席扣總成績2分，兩次請假視為一次缺席，缺席5次本項以零分計算。
gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: 2 points will be deducted for each absence. Students who are absent five times will receive 0 points for attendance.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1.	準時上課並尊重師生互動。
2.	出席率將影響期末成績。
3.	課堂中需積極參與討論與活動。
4.	作業須於指定時間繳交，逾期酌扣分數。
Classroom Regulations
1.	Students are expected to arrive on time and show respect in teacher–student interactions.
2.	Attendance will affect the final grade.
3.	Active participation in class discussions and activities is required.
4.	Assignments must be submitted on time; late submissions will result in grade deductions.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en: Students are expected to attend classes regularly, participate actively in discussions and activities, and complete all assignments on time. Late submissions may result in grade deductions unless prior arrangements have been made with the instructor. Please respect classmates’ ideas during discussions and maintain a positive and collaborative learning environment. If you encounter difficulties during the course, do not hesitate to communicate with the instructor early.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Please respect classmates’ ideas during discussions and maintain a positive and collaborative learning environment. If you encounter difficulties during the course, do not hesitate to communicate with the instructor early.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
本課程強調學術誠信，嚴禁抄襲、代寫或未經授權之使用。所有報告與設計成果必須為學生原創，引用資料需標明出處。違反者將依校規處理，並影響學期成績。
This course emphasizes academic integrity. Plagiarism, ghostwriting, or unauthorized use of materials is strictly prohibited. All reports and design works must be the student’s original creation, and all references must be properly cited. Any violation will be handled in accordance with university regulations and will affect the final grade.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to maintain academic integrity in all coursework. All submitted work must be original and properly acknowledge any sources used. Plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, or submission of others’ work is prohibited. AI tools may be used as supportive tools, but students must ensure that the final work reflects their own understanding and design decisions.
